verdict.rationale: Khoj lets self-hosters configure several chat models and providers and switch between them manually. Nothing in the evidence shows automatic fallback to another model or provider when one errors or rate-limits. Routing through LiteLLM is an external tool, so it is a user-side workaround and earns no credit, and manual model switching is an adjacent feature rather than failover.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
